table.name: analysis_file_experiment_info
table.viewSql: WITH signal_files AS ( SELECT analysis_file.analysis_file_id AS signal_analysis_file_id, analysis_file.experiment_id AS signal_experiment_id, assembly_1.assembly_id AS signal_assembly_id, s3_object.key AS signal_key FROM (((analysis_file JOIN assembly assembly_1 ON ((analysis_file.assembly_id = assembly_1.assembly_id))) JOIN file ON ((analysis_file.file_id = file.file_id))) JOIN s3_object ON ((file.file_id = s3_object.file_id))) WHERE (analysis_file.analysis_type = 'signal'::analysis_type) ), atac_seq_peak_files AS ( SELECT analysis_file.analysis_file_id AS atac_seq_peak_analysis_file_id, analysis_file.experiment_id AS atac_seq_peak_experiment_id, assembly_1.assembly_id AS atac_seq_peak_assembly_id, s3_object.key AS atac_seq_peak_key FROM (((analysis_file JOIN assembly assembly_1 ON ((analysis_file.assembly_id = assembly_1.assembly_id))) JOIN file ON ((analysis_file.file_id = file.file_id))) JOIN s3_object ON ((file.file_id = s3_object.file_id))) WHERE (analysis_file.analysis_type = 'atac_seq_peaks'::analysis_type) ), dnase_seq_peak_files AS ( SELECT analysis_file.analysis_file_id AS dnase_seq_peak_analysis_file_id, analysis_file.experiment_id AS dnase_seq_peak_experiment_id, assembly_1.assembly_id AS dnase_seq_peak_assembly_id, s3_object.key AS dnase_seq_peak_key FROM (((analysis_file JOIN assembly assembly_1 ON ((analysis_file.assembly_id = assembly_1.assembly_id))) JOIN file ON ((analysis_file.file_id = file.file_id))) JOIN s3_object ON ((file.file_id = s3_object.file_id))) WHERE (analysis_file.analysis_type = 'dnase_seq_peaks'::analysis_type) ), chip_seq_narrow_peak_files AS ( SELECT analysis_file.analysis_file_id AS chip_seq_narrow_peak_analysis_file_id, analysis_file.experiment_id AS chip_seq_narrow_peak_experiment_id, assembly_1.assembly_id AS chip_seq_narrow_peak_assembly_id, s3_object.key AS chip_seq_narrow_peak_key FROM (((analysis_file JOIN assembly assembly_1 ON ((analysis_file.assembly_id = assembly_1.assembly_id))) JOIN file ON ((analysis_file.file_id = file.file_id))) JOIN s3_object ON ((file.file_id = s3_object.file_id))) WHERE (analysis_file.analysis_type = 'chip_seq_narrow_peaks'::analysis_type) ), chip_seq_broad_peak_files AS ( SELECT analysis_file.analysis_file_id AS chip_seq_broad_peak_analysis_file_id, analysis_file.experiment_id AS chip_seq_broad_peak_experiment_id, assembly_1.assembly_id AS chip_seq_broad_peak_assembly_id, s3_object.key AS chip_seq_broad_peak_key FROM (((analysis_file JOIN assembly assembly_1 ON ((analysis_file.assembly_id = assembly_1.assembly_id))) JOIN file ON ((analysis_file.file_id = file.file_id))) JOIN s3_object ON ((file.file_id = s3_object.file_id))) WHERE (analysis_file.analysis_type = 'chip_seq_broad_peaks'::analysis_type) ), chip_seq_gapped_peak_files AS ( SELECT analysis_file.analysis_file_id AS chip_seq_gapped_peak_analysis_file_id, analysis_file.experiment_id AS chip_seq_gapped_peak_experiment_id, assembly_1.assembly_id AS chip_seq_gapped_peak_assembly_id, s3_object.key AS chip_seq_gapped_peak_key FROM (((analysis_file JOIN assembly assembly_1 ON ((analysis_file.assembly_id = assembly_1.assembly_id))) JOIN file ON ((analysis_file.file_id = file.file_id))) JOIN s3_object ON ((file.file_id = s3_object.file_id))) WHERE (analysis_file.analysis_type = 'chip_seq_gapped_peaks'::analysis_type) ) SELECT experiment_signal_and_control_data_source.species_name, experiment_signal_and_control_data_source.species_id, experiment_signal_and_control_data_source.description, experiment_signal_and_control_data_source.epigenome_group_id, experiment_signal_and_control_data_source.epigenome_accession, experiment_signal_and_control_data_source.epigenome_name, experiment_signal_and_control_data_source.epigenome_description, experiment_signal_and_control_data_source.epigenome_id, experiment_signal_and_control_data_source.experiment_name, experiment_signal_and_control_data_source.experiment_id, experiment_signal_and_control_data_source.experiment_type, experiment_signal_and_control_data_source.experiment_target_type, experiment_signal_and_control_data_source.experiment_target, experiment_signal_and_control_data_source.signal_replicate_set_accession, experiment_signal_and_control_data_source.signal_replicate_set_id, experiment_signal_and_control_data_source.control_replicate_set_accession, experiment_signal_and_control_data_source.control_replicate_set_id, assembly.ensembl_accession, COALESCE(atac_seq_peak_files.atac_seq_peak_key, dnase_seq_peak_files.dnase_seq_peak_key) AS open_chromatin_peak, chip_seq_narrow_peak_files.chip_seq_narrow_peak_key, chip_seq_broad_peak_files.chip_seq_broad_peak_key, chip_seq_gapped_peak_files.chip_seq_gapped_peak_key, signal_files.signal_key FROM (((((((experiment_signal_and_control_data_source JOIN assembly ON ((experiment_signal_and_control_data_source.species_id = assembly.species_id))) LEFT JOIN signal_files ON (((experiment_signal_and_control_data_source.experiment_id = signal_files.signal_experiment_id) AND (signal_files.signal_assembly_id = assembly.assembly_id)))) LEFT JOIN atac_seq_peak_files ON (((experiment_signal_and_control_data_source.experiment_id = atac_seq_peak_files.atac_seq_peak_experiment_id) AND (atac_seq_peak_files.atac_seq_peak_assembly_id = assembly.assembly_id)))) LEFT JOIN dnase_seq_peak_files ON (((experiment_signal_and_control_data_source.experiment_id = dnase_seq_peak_files.dnase_seq_peak_experiment_id) AND (dnase_seq_peak_files.dnase_seq_peak_assembly_id = assembly.assembly_id)))) LEFT JOIN chip_seq_narrow_peak_files ON (((experiment_signal_and_control_data_source.experiment_id = chip_seq_narrow_peak_files.chip_seq_narrow_peak_experiment_id) AND (chip_seq_narrow_peak_files.chip_seq_narrow_peak_assembly_id = assembly.assembly_id)))) LEFT JOIN chip_seq_broad_peak_files ON (((experiment_signal_and_control_data_source.experiment_id = chip_seq_broad_peak_files.chip_seq_broad_peak_experiment_id) AND (chip_seq_broad_peak_files.chip_seq_broad_peak_assembly_id = assembly.assembly_id)))) LEFT JOIN chip_seq_gapped_peak_files ON (((experiment_signal_and_control_data_source.experiment_id = chip_seq_gapped_peak_files.chip_seq_gapped_peak_experiment_id) AND (chip_seq_gapped_peak_files.chip_seq_gapped_peak_assembly_id = assembly.assembly_id))));

table.name: analysis_file_info_with_checks
table.viewSql: SELECT analysis_file_experiment_info.species_name, analysis_file_experiment_info.species_id, analysis_file_experiment_info.description, analysis_file_experiment_info.epigenome_group_id, analysis_file_experiment_info.epigenome_accession, analysis_file_experiment_info.epigenome_name, analysis_file_experiment_info.epigenome_description, analysis_file_experiment_info.epigenome_id, analysis_file_experiment_info.experiment_name, analysis_file_experiment_info.experiment_id, analysis_file_experiment_info.experiment_type, analysis_file_experiment_info.experiment_target_type, analysis_file_experiment_info.experiment_target, analysis_file_experiment_info.signal_replicate_set_accession, analysis_file_experiment_info.signal_replicate_set_id, analysis_file_experiment_info.control_replicate_set_accession, analysis_file_experiment_info.control_replicate_set_id, analysis_file_experiment_info.ensembl_accession, analysis_file_experiment_info.open_chromatin_peak, analysis_file_experiment_info.chip_seq_narrow_peak_key, analysis_file_experiment_info.chip_seq_broad_peak_key, analysis_file_experiment_info.chip_seq_gapped_peak_key, analysis_file_experiment_info.signal_key, CASE WHEN ((analysis_file_experiment_info.experiment_type = 'chip_seq'::experiment_type) AND (analysis_file_experiment_info.chip_seq_narrow_peak_key IS NULL)) THEN 'Missing peaks file: ChIP-seq general case check'::text WHEN ((analysis_file_experiment_info.experiment_target_type = ANY (ARRAY['H3K27me3'::text, 'H3K4me1'::text])) AND ((analysis_file_experiment_info.chip_seq_narrow_peak_key IS NULL) OR (analysis_file_experiment_info.chip_seq_broad_peak_key IS NULL) OR (analysis_file_experiment_info.chip_seq_gapped_peak_key IS NULL))) THEN 'Missing some of multiple peaks files expected: ChIP-seq check for broad histone marker cases'::text WHEN ((analysis_file_experiment_info.experiment_target_type = ANY (ARRAY['atac_seq'::text, 'dnase_seq'::text])) AND (analysis_file_experiment_info.open_chromatin_peak IS NULL)) THEN 'Missing peaks: Open-chromatin case check'::text ELSE 'Ok'::text END AS beds_available, CASE WHEN (analysis_file_experiment_info.signal_key IS NULL) THEN 'Missing signal'::text ELSE 'Ok'::text END AS bigwig_available FROM analysis_file_experiment_info;

table.name: biosample_data_source
table.viewSql: WITH biosample_ds AS ( SELECT biosample_1.biosample_id, data_source.accession AS biosample_accession FROM (biosample biosample_1 LEFT JOIN data_source ON ((biosample_1.data_source_id = data_source.data_source_id))) ), biosample_alternative_ds AS ( SELECT biosample_1.biosample_id, data_source.accession AS biosample_alternative_accession FROM (biosample biosample_1 LEFT JOIN data_source ON ((biosample_1.alternative_data_source_id = data_source.data_source_id))) ) SELECT biosample.biosample_id, biosample.biomaterial_type, biosample.term, biosample.data_source_id, biosample.ontology_id, biosample.biosource_id, biosample.treatments, biosample.perturbed, biosample.disease_term_id, biosample.disease_term_name, biosample.health_status, biosample.genetic_modifications, biosample.alternative_data_source_id, biosample.organ_slims, biosample.cell_slims, biosample.developmental_slims, biosample.system_slims, biosample.synonyms, biosample.age_at_collection, biosample.age_at_collection_unit, biosample.time_post_fertilisation, biosample.time_post_fertilisation_unit, biosample.thermal_time, biosample.life_stage_id, biosample_ds.biosample_accession, biosample_alternative_ds.biosample_alternative_accession FROM ((biosample LEFT JOIN biosample_ds ON ((biosample.biosample_id = biosample_ds.biosample_id))) LEFT JOIN biosample_alternative_ds ON ((biosample.biosample_id = biosample_alternative_ds.biosample_id)));

table.name: biosample_set_data_source
table.viewSql: SELECT biosample_set.biosample_set_id, biosample_set.biosample_set_type, biosample_set.data_source_id, data_source.accession FROM (biosample_set LEFT JOIN data_source ON ((biosample_set.data_source_id = data_source.data_source_id)));

table.name: biosource_data_source
table.viewSql: WITH biosource_ds AS ( SELECT biosource_1.biosource_id, data_source.accession AS biosource_accession FROM (biosource biosource_1 LEFT JOIN data_source ON ((biosource_1.data_source_id = data_source.data_source_id))) ), biosource_alternative_ds AS ( SELECT biosource_1.biosource_id, data_source.accession AS biosource_alternative_accession FROM (biosource biosource_1 LEFT JOIN data_source ON ((biosource_1.alternative_data_source_id = data_source.data_source_id))) ) SELECT biosource.biosource_id, biosource.sex, biosource.age_unit, biosource.data_source_id, biosource.age, biosource.alternative_data_source_id, biosource.life_stage_id, biosource_ds.biosource_accession, biosource_alternative_ds.biosource_alternative_accession FROM ((biosource LEFT JOIN biosource_ds ON ((biosource.biosource_id = biosource_ds.biosource_id))) LEFT JOIN biosource_alternative_ds ON ((biosource.biosource_id = biosource_alternative_ds.biosource_id)));

table.name: epigenome_data_source
table.viewSql: SELECT epigenome.name, epigenome.description, epigenome.epigenome_id, epigenome.epigenome_group_id, epigenome.species_id, epigenome.data_source_id, data_source.accession AS epigenome_accession FROM (epigenome LEFT JOIN data_source ON ((epigenome.data_source_id = data_source.data_source_id)));

table.name: experiment_control_data_source
table.viewSql: SELECT experiment_control_target_info.name, experiment_control_target_info.experiment_type, experiment_control_target_info.epigenome_id, experiment_control_target_info.experiment_id, experiment_control_target_info.data_source_id, experiment_control_target_info.replicate_set_id, experiment_control_target_info.replicate_set_type, experiment_control_target_info.experiment_target_type, experiment_control_target_info.experiment_target, replicate_set_data_source.replicate_set_accession FROM (experiment_control_target_info LEFT JOIN replicate_set_data_source ON ((experiment_control_target_info.replicate_set_id = replicate_set_data_source.replicate_set_id)));

table.name: experiment_control_target_info
table.viewSql: SELECT experiment.name, experiment.experiment_type, experiment.epigenome_id, experiment.experiment_id, experiment.data_source_id, replicate_set.replicate_set_id, 'control'::text AS replicate_set_type, NULL::text AS experiment_target_type, NULL::text AS experiment_target FROM ((experiment JOIN chip_seq ON ((experiment.experiment_id = chip_seq.experiment_id))) JOIN replicate_set ON ((chip_seq.control = replicate_set.replicate_set_id)));

table.name: experiment_data_source
table.viewSql: SELECT experiment_signal_data_source.name, experiment_signal_data_source.experiment_type, experiment_signal_data_source.epigenome_id, experiment_signal_data_source.experiment_id, experiment_signal_data_source.data_source_id, experiment_signal_data_source.replicate_set_id, experiment_signal_data_source.replicate_set_type, experiment_signal_data_source.experiment_target_type, experiment_signal_data_source.experiment_target, experiment_signal_data_source.replicate_set_accession FROM experiment_signal_data_source UNION ALL SELECT experiment_control_data_source.name, experiment_control_data_source.experiment_type, experiment_control_data_source.epigenome_id, experiment_control_data_source.experiment_id, experiment_control_data_source.data_source_id, experiment_control_data_source.replicate_set_id, experiment_control_data_source.replicate_set_type, experiment_control_data_source.experiment_target_type, experiment_control_data_source.experiment_target, experiment_control_data_source.replicate_set_accession FROM experiment_control_data_source;

table.name: experiment_metadata
table.viewSql: SELECT species.name AS species_name, species.species_id, epigenome_group.description AS epigenome_group_description, epigenome_group.epigenome_group_id, epigenome_data_source.epigenome_accession, epigenome_data_source.name AS epigenome_name, epigenome_data_source.description AS epigenome_description, experiment_data_source.name, experiment_data_source.experiment_type, experiment_data_source.epigenome_id, experiment_data_source.experiment_id, experiment_data_source.data_source_id, experiment_data_source.replicate_set_id, experiment_data_source.replicate_set_type, experiment_data_source.experiment_target_type, experiment_data_source.experiment_target, experiment_data_source.replicate_set_accession, replicate_data_source.replicate_id, replicate_data_source.replicate_accession, replicate_data_source.biosample_set_id, biosample_set_data_source.biosample_set_type, biosample_set_data_source.accession, biosample_data_source.biosample_id, biosample_data_source.biosample_accession, biosample_data_source.biosample_alternative_accession, biosample_data_source.biomaterial_type, biosample_data_source.term AS biosample_term, biosample_data_source.ontology_id, ontology.ontology_type, ontology.curie, biosample_data_source.organ_slims, biosample_data_source.cell_slims, biosample_data_source.developmental_slims, biosample_data_source.system_slims, biosample_data_source.synonyms, life_stage_with_ontology.life_stage_id, life_stage_with_ontology.life_stage_term, life_stage_with_ontology.life_stage_ontology_relation, life_stage_with_ontology.life_stage_ontology_id, life_stage_with_ontology.life_stage_ontology_type, life_stage_with_ontology.life_stage_ontology_curie, biosample_data_source.age_at_collection, biosample_data_source.age_at_collection_unit, biosample_data_source.time_post_fertilisation, biosample_data_source.time_post_fertilisation_unit, biosample_data_source.thermal_time, biosample_data_source.perturbed, biosample_data_source.treatments, biosample_data_source.health_status, biosample_data_source.disease_term_id, biosample_data_source.disease_term_name, biosample_data_source.genetic_modifications, biosource_data_source.biosource_accession, biosource_data_source.biosource_alternative_accession, biosource_data_source.age, biosource_data_source.age_unit, biosource_data_source.sex FROM (((((((((((species JOIN epigenome_data_source ON ((species.species_id = epigenome_data_source.species_id))) JOIN epigenome_group ON ((epigenome_data_source.epigenome_group_id = epigenome_group.epigenome_group_id))) JOIN experiment_data_source ON ((epigenome_data_source.epigenome_id = experiment_data_source.epigenome_id))) JOIN replicate_set ON ((experiment_data_source.replicate_set_id = replicate_set.replicate_set_id))) JOIN replicate_data_source ON ((replicate_set.replicate_set_id = replicate_data_source.replicate_set_id))) LEFT JOIN biosample_set_data_source ON ((replicate_data_source.biosample_set_id = biosample_set_data_source.biosample_set_id))) LEFT JOIN biosample_set_biosample ON ((biosample_set_data_source.biosample_set_id = biosample_set_biosample.biosample_set_id))) LEFT JOIN biosample_data_source ON ((biosample_set_biosample.biosample_id = biosample_data_source.biosample_id))) LEFT JOIN ontology ON ((biosample_data_source.ontology_id = ontology.ontology_id))) LEFT JOIN biosource_data_source ON ((biosample_data_source.biosource_id = biosource_data_source.biosource_id))) LEFT JOIN life_stage_with_ontology ON (((biosample_data_source.life_stage_id = life_stage_with_ontology.life_stage_id) OR (biosource_data_source.life_stage_id = life_stage_with_ontology.life_stage_id))));

table.name: experiment_signal_and_control_data_source
table.viewSql: SELECT species.name AS species_name, species.species_id, epigenome_group.description, epigenome_group.epigenome_group_id, epigenome_data_source.epigenome_accession, epigenome_data_source.name AS epigenome_name, epigenome_data_source.description AS epigenome_description, epigenome_data_source.epigenome_id, experiment_signal_data_source.name AS experiment_name, experiment_signal_data_source.experiment_id, experiment_signal_data_source.experiment_type, experiment_signal_data_source.experiment_target_type, experiment_signal_data_source.experiment_target, experiment_signal_data_source.replicate_set_accession AS signal_replicate_set_accession, experiment_signal_data_source.replicate_set_id AS signal_replicate_set_id, experiment_control_data_source.replicate_set_accession AS control_replicate_set_accession, experiment_control_data_source.replicate_set_id AS control_replicate_set_id FROM ((((species JOIN epigenome_data_source ON ((species.species_id = epigenome_data_source.species_id))) JOIN epigenome_group ON ((epigenome_data_source.epigenome_group_id = epigenome_group.epigenome_group_id))) JOIN experiment_signal_data_source ON ((epigenome_data_source.epigenome_id = experiment_signal_data_source.epigenome_id))) LEFT JOIN experiment_control_data_source ON ((experiment_signal_data_source.experiment_id = experiment_control_data_source.experiment_id)));

table.name: experiment_signal_data_source
table.viewSql: SELECT experiment_signal_target_info.name, experiment_signal_target_info.experiment_type, experiment_signal_target_info.epigenome_id, experiment_signal_target_info.experiment_id, experiment_signal_target_info.data_source_id, experiment_signal_target_info.replicate_set_id, experiment_signal_target_info.replicate_set_type, experiment_signal_target_info.experiment_target_type, experiment_signal_target_info.experiment_target, replicate_set_data_source.replicate_set_accession FROM (experiment_signal_target_info LEFT JOIN replicate_set_data_source ON ((experiment_signal_target_info.replicate_set_id = replicate_set_data_source.replicate_set_id)));

table.name: experiment_signal_target_info
table.viewSql: SELECT experiment.name, experiment.experiment_type, experiment.epigenome_id, experiment.experiment_id, experiment.data_source_id, replicate_set.replicate_set_id, 'signal'::text AS replicate_set_type, COALESCE((chip_seq.target_type)::text, (experiment.experiment_type)::text) AS experiment_target_type, COALESCE((histone_target.name)::text, (tf_target.name)::text, (experiment.experiment_type)::text) AS experiment_target FROM ((((((experiment LEFT JOIN atac_seq ON ((experiment.experiment_id = atac_seq.experiment_id))) LEFT JOIN dnase_seq ON ((experiment.experiment_id = dnase_seq.experiment_id))) LEFT JOIN chip_seq ON ((experiment.experiment_id = chip_seq.experiment_id))) LEFT JOIN replicate_set ON (((atac_seq.replicate_set_id = replicate_set.replicate_set_id) OR (dnase_seq.replicate_set_id = replicate_set.replicate_set_id) OR (chip_seq.signal = replicate_set.replicate_set_id)))) LEFT JOIN histone_target ON ((chip_seq.histone_target_id = histone_target.histone_target_id))) LEFT JOIN tf_target ON ((chip_seq.tf_target_id = tf_target.tf_target_id)));

table.name: experiment_target_info
table.viewSql: SELECT experiment_signal_target_info.name, experiment_signal_target_info.experiment_type, experiment_signal_target_info.epigenome_id, experiment_signal_target_info.experiment_id, experiment_signal_target_info.data_source_id, experiment_signal_target_info.replicate_set_id, experiment_signal_target_info.replicate_set_type, experiment_signal_target_info.experiment_target_type, experiment_signal_target_info.experiment_target FROM experiment_signal_target_info UNION ALL SELECT experiment_control_target_info.name, experiment_control_target_info.experiment_type, experiment_control_target_info.epigenome_id, experiment_control_target_info.experiment_id, experiment_control_target_info.data_source_id, experiment_control_target_info.replicate_set_id, experiment_control_target_info.replicate_set_type, experiment_control_target_info.experiment_target_type, experiment_control_target_info.experiment_target FROM experiment_control_target_info;

table.name: library_data_source
table.viewSql: SELECT read_file_set.read_file_set_id, read_file_set.data_source_id, data_source.accession AS library_accession FROM (read_file_set LEFT JOIN data_source ON ((read_file_set.data_source_id = data_source.data_source_id)));

table.name: life_stage_with_ontology
table.viewSql: SELECT life_stage.life_stage_id, life_stage.term AS life_stage_term, life_stage.ontology_relation AS life_stage_ontology_relation, life_stage.ontology_id AS life_stage_ontology_id, ontology.ontology_type AS life_stage_ontology_type, ontology.curie AS life_stage_ontology_curie FROM (life_stage JOIN ontology ON ((life_stage.ontology_id = ontology.ontology_id)));

table.name: metadata_dimension_age
table.viewSql: SELECT DISTINCT metadata_expr_agg.species_name, COALESCE((min( CASE WHEN (metadata_expr_agg.age = 'unknown'::text) THEN NULL::double precision ELSE (metadata_expr_agg.age)::double precision END))::text, 'unknown'::text) AS min_value, COALESCE((max( CASE WHEN (metadata_expr_agg.age = 'unknown'::text) THEN NULL::double precision ELSE (metadata_expr_agg.age)::double precision END))::text, 'unknown'::text) AS max_value, COALESCE(metadata_expr_agg.age_unit, 'unknown'::text) AS unit FROM metadata_expr_agg GROUP BY metadata_expr_agg.species_name, metadata_expr_agg.age_unit ORDER BY metadata_expr_agg.species_name;

table.name: metadata_dimension_experiment_target
table.viewSql: SELECT DISTINCT metadata_expr_agg.species_name, unnest(metadata_expr_agg.experiment_targets) AS name FROM metadata_expr_agg ORDER BY metadata_expr_agg.species_name;

table.name: metadata_dimension_experiment_target_type
table.viewSql: SELECT DISTINCT metadata_expr_agg.species_name, unnest(metadata_expr_agg.experiment_target_types) AS name FROM metadata_expr_agg ORDER BY metadata_expr_agg.species_name;

table.name: metadata_dimension_experiment_type
table.viewSql: SELECT DISTINCT metadata_expr_agg.species_name, unnest(metadata_expr_agg.experiment_types) AS name FROM metadata_expr_agg ORDER BY metadata_expr_agg.species_name;

table.name: metadata_dimension_life_stage
table.viewSql: SELECT DISTINCT metadata_expr_agg.species_name, metadata_expr_agg.life_stage AS name FROM metadata_expr_agg ORDER BY metadata_expr_agg.species_name;

table.name: metadata_dimension_material
table.viewSql: SELECT DISTINCT metadata_expr_agg.species_name, metadata_expr_agg.material AS name FROM metadata_expr_agg ORDER BY metadata_expr_agg.species_name;

table.name: metadata_dimension_organ
table.viewSql: SELECT DISTINCT metadata_expr_agg.species_name, unnest(metadata_expr_agg.organ_slims) AS name, array_agg(DISTINCT metadata_expr_agg.term) AS terms FROM metadata_expr_agg GROUP BY metadata_expr_agg.species_name, (unnest(metadata_expr_agg.organ_slims)) ORDER BY metadata_expr_agg.species_name;

table.name: metadata_dimension_sex
table.viewSql: SELECT DISTINCT metadata_expr_agg.species_name, metadata_expr_agg.sex AS name FROM metadata_expr_agg ORDER BY metadata_expr_agg.species_name;

table.name: metadata_dimension_system
table.viewSql: SELECT DISTINCT metadata_expr_agg.species_name, unnest(metadata_expr_agg.system_slims) AS name, array_agg(DISTINCT metadata_expr_agg.term) AS terms FROM metadata_expr_agg GROUP BY metadata_expr_agg.species_name, (unnest(metadata_expr_agg.system_slims)) ORDER BY metadata_expr_agg.species_name;

table.name: metadata_dimension_term
